itens.titulo: Bowmasters and Friends: the new Historic metagame after the rebalanced cards got reverted
itens.resumo: Aneurin analyzes the Historic metagame after the Alchemy rebalances got reverted: the impact of Orcish Bowmasters on the format, which decks got better, which ones became possible, including Geological Appraiser Combo (and a bonus Winota decklists!)

itens.titulo: Dados de Star Trek para Magic chegam em novembro com caixas surpresa
